title: Declaration
meaning: The one file that states what a service is. An agent writes it, and it is the only input STEGO accepts for a service.

title: Archetype
meaning: The curated component set a declaration selects, which decides its shape and conventions.

title: Entity
meaning: A data shape a declaration names, with fields and their constraints and no access pattern.

title: Collection
meaning: An access pattern over one entity: its scope, its operations and its path.

title: Slot binding
meaning: A place where a service binds its own rules, as fills, to a slot a component declares.

title: Fill
meaning: Code an author or an agent writes against a generated slot contract. STEGO does not generate it.

title: Fault
meaning: One way a declaration breaks a rule, given as structured data an agent can act on.

title: Experimental acceptance
meaning: A statement in a declaration that it accepts a component that is not ga, until a date.
